reason: The README clearly describes an agent-facing browser automation plugin that drives isolated headless Edge or Chrome sessions, performs navigation and page interactions, and exposes a live cockpit panel.

summaries.zh: 通过聊天驱动隔离的无头 Edge 或 Chrome 浏览器，支持页面读取、点击、输入、导航、截图和脚本执行。
summaries.en: Drive isolated headless Edge or Chrome browser sessions from chat with page reading, clicking, typing, navigation, screenshots, and page-context scripting.

capabilities: Controls a headless Edge or Chrome browser through CDP
Navigates pages and reads structured DOM text snapshots
Clicks, types, presses keys, waits, reloads, and goes back
Takes screenshots and downloads page resources
Evaluates JavaScript in the page context
Provides a live cockpit panel for browser session visibility and control
